items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Wellman Braud was the first bass player I became conscious of.

ctx.x: Yeah, so... I don't know whether it was Wellman Braud or not. The first time I actually saw the band, Wellman Braud was playing bass, and I used to sit in front of the band in awe, digging these guys. Years later,
